task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, make an attempt to take a trip west. After that, attempt to move south. Then, move west. With that accomplished, make an effort to head west. With that accomplished, travel south. And then, attempt to head south. With that over with, go to the east. And then, make an effort to go to the east. That done, venture north. With that over with, head north. Then, travel north. After that, make an effort to move east. And then, attempt to venture east. With that done, travel south. And then, venture east. After that, make an effort to go north. Following that, lift the coin from the floor of the silent workshop. That's it!
